lens.reason: VexLife Prod describes its UI as a Kotlin Multiplatform Blueprint (VexUiBlueprint) rendered through VexWeb, not with the Android element DSL, so the Android adapter cannot read it.
lens.next: Export the Blueprint into the same Screen Lens schema (preferred over text parsing, because the Blueprint is already explicit), then add its builds here.

subjects.label: VexBoard
subjects.summary: This tool, looking at itself: the projects entry, the Screen Lens and the canvas that came before it.

lens.reason: VexBoard is a web app. A Screen Lens of it needs a web adapter that reads its pages and page state, which does not exist yet.
lens.next: Project projects.html and lens.html through a web adapter that can expose their screens, interactions and page state; let semantic ownership be earned from the web source instead of prescribing a Family in advance.
